title: PortoSlop, the GTA we deserve, BUT in Porto!
author: 30crlh
selftext:
Started a a silly idea for a group of friends but in all honestly we've had so much fun already. It's basically a 1 to 1 rendition of Porto and Gaia downtowns with all streets, bridges, some monuments (and those hills!). Truly low poly, max slop and filled with bugs, but man have we gotten some laughs out of it.

Got to [PortoSlop](https://porto.tremocogames.com/), pick a name, a shirt color and you're in

# Features

1. Multiplayer
2. Mobile (hello loo time)
3. Different characters to pick from
4. Jobs and economy
5. Car tuning, boats, planes, etc
6. You can destroy all buildings
7. A feedback system that my "portuguese friend" *Cláudio* will read from and implement on a moment's notice.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/30crlh please update this post with more on how you used AI to build the game. A line saying it was made with AI isn't enough. Share dev details. Rule 4 is there so promotional posts add to the sub by talking about the process and real development. We don't want the sub drowned in empty promotion. Posts that aren't updated may be removed.
